title: Wright price-to-supply reduced form
content: Figure 7.10's simultaneous system reduced in the opposite direction: Yield-to-Supply-to-Price is replaced by Yield-to-Price, so Demand instruments Price for the effect of Price on Supply.

variables.name: Price
variables.content: The treatment in this direction-specific reduction.

variables.name: Supply
variables.content: The outcome in this direction-specific reduction.

arrows.because: Figure 7.10 makes Demand directly affect Price.
Figure 7.10 makes Yield per Acre directly affect Supply.
The opposite directional reduction replaces Yield-to-Supply-to-Price by this reduced-form arrow.
This directional reduction retains the Price-to-Supply causal coefficient.
